note: joint_sign -1 flips that horn. lift_sign -1 flips carriage travel. wheel_sign order is left, back, right. The base starts at the origin and is odometry from commanded vx/vy/wz. The lift starts at lift_start_m and then follows unwrapped tick deltas (the servo position wraps every revolution). Press R in the viewer to zero the base and re-anchor the lift.
